notes.title: Patch Update 🌧️
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We’ve just released a small patch with a few improvements to make your Devil’s Drizzle experience smoother. Nothing major this time, just polishing things here and there.

Thank you all for playing and for your amazing feedback, it really helps us keep improving the game! ❤️

notes.title: NEW VISUAL PROTECTION MODE
notes.content:
[h2]We’ve added a Visual Protection Mode to Devil’s Drizzle![/h2][p]This option removes certain visual effects from the screen to improve comfort for players with keratoconus or other types of visual sensitivity.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077437/ef3bcec9fbbe3eacd1940b05a90bab5c624532e0.png"][/img]
[/p][p]🔹 Can be enabled directly from the main menu.[/p][p]🔹 More accessibility, more comfort, more rain for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support, and please keep sharing your feedback! ❤️[/p]

notes.title: Minor bugs fixed
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed some bugs related to SFX.
[*] Adjusted the balance of Hard difficulty.
[*] Added a photosensitivity warning at the start of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: THE STORM IS HERE! DEVIL'S DRIZZLE IS AVAILABLE NOW.
notes.content:
[h1][b]⛈️DEVIL’S DRIZZLEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!!!⛈️[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]That’s right! We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Devil’s Drizzle[/i] is now available to play! We’re deeply grateful for all the support from the very beginning of development up to now. We wish everyone an amazing gameplay and hope you enjoy the experience we’ve created for you![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🐞Found a bug?[/b][/h3][p]
Feel free to report it in the Steam Community section, on our social media, or via email at contato@zntprod.com.br, we want [i]Devil’s Drizzle[/i] to be the best experience possible, so let’s hunt down and squash those bugs fast![/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely, [/p][p]The Cozy Creeps Games & ZNT Productions Team[/p]

notes.title: 🚨 Release date update 🚨
notes.content:
[p]For strategic reasons, the launch has been postponed by 4 days. Just a little more waiting!

I’m really excited and can’t wait to share my game with you. 

☔🐸[/p]
